D1_hybrid_literature_ownership.evidence: KAD owns canonical ResearchDocument, identifiers, source hashes, and provenance; Zotero is not canonical authority.

D2_layered_research_contract.evidence: ResearchCandidate -> ResearchSource -> ResearchDocument layers implemented with explicit unknown/null values, no fabrication, and deterministic SHA-256 content hashing.

D4_deterministic_research_api.evidence: DeterministicResearchCorpus and standalone helper functions own validation, normalization, identifier precedence, hashing, deduplication, conflict detection, provenance, and persistence.

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Layered ResearchCandidate, ResearchIdentifier, ResearchSource, ResearchDocument, and ResearchProvenance state is deterministic and explicit about unknown values.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: ResearchCandidate preserves explicit nulls, is non-authoritative, and does not fabricate fields

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Identifiers and local source hashes support duplicate detection, idempotent import, and conflict rejection.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: DeterministicResearchCorpus provides idempotent ingestion and deduplication; DeterministicResearchCorpus fails closed on conflicting identity evidence

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Malformed metadata and unsafe paths fail before canonical mutation.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: ResearchSource safely resolves local files, hashes bytes deterministically, and rejects unsafe paths

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Provenance and source references survive persistence; derived metadata cannot overwrite canonical source state.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: Derived or external metadata cannot overwrite canonical accepted source data; Corpus persistence survives reload and provides atomic state management

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Baseline tests require no API key, paid provider, remote model, or OpenViking service.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: Research corpus operations execute with zero external network or model dependency
